methodology.scope: NumPy SVD/algebra on saved NPZ only; no OpenSim import, FK, integration, model edit, IK solve, force fitting or new detector.
methodology.Kabsch: Column-vector center=R*local+p; covariance local_centered.T*world_centered; R=V*diag(1,1,sign(det(VU.T)))*U.T, p=world_mean-R*local_mean.
methodology.signed_depth: radius+planeY-pY-(R*local07)Y. Shared radius and plane cancel exactly in AB07-minus-AB06.
methodology.phase_pooling: 20 equal measured-HS→TO stance bins per frozen cycle; time-weighted bin means, then cycle-duration-weighted pooling. Equal1/20 phase weights for pair difference summary.
methodology.interpolation: Piecewise-linear recovered pY and rotated-point-Y values at saved native1ms+exactevent grid; interpolation only inserts bin endpoints, with no rotation-matrix interpolation.
methodology.positive_penetration: max(raw_depth,0) is reported separately; its B-minus-A cannot be decomposed by independently clipping origin/orientation terms.
methodology.orientation: The entire recovered rigid rotation acting on the eccentric local basis07 point; no isolation of one anatomical joint or preparation parameter.

limits: Origin/rotation are descriptive factors of the foot pose under each complete prepared reference, not exclusively anatomy or preparation.
Shape RMS components are not additive; their covariance/cross-term is required. Mean signed-depth contributions are additive by identity.
A constant-depth descriptive offset does not identify a physical floor, marker-registration error or a transferable contact law.
Phase normalization is diagnostic shape comparison, not a replacement for native timing or main impulse scoring.
